Subject: Data Structures
Unit 1 Arrays and Linked Lists
1. Which data structure uses LIFO order? [2 marks]
A) Queue
B) Stack
C) Tree
D) Graph
2. Time complexity of accessing an array element by index is
A. O(n)
B. O(log n)
C. O(1)
D. O(n^2)
Unit 2 Trees
3. A binary tree with n nodes has at most how many leaves? (A) n (B) n/2 (C) n-1 (D) log n
Answer: A
4. In-order traversal of a BST yields
A) random order
B) sorted order
C) reverse order
D) level order
Answer Key
1-B 2-C 4-B
